title: Beetle Cult Ritual
description: A large metallic beetle with multiple arms, a glowing halo, and holding ritual items stands atop a dark mound of skulls. Below, hooded figures in white and black robes form a circle around a ritual diagram, surrounded by candles, floating halos, and colorful flames against a dark, ornate background with banners and symbols.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a giant metallic beetle with multiple arms, glowing halo rings, and holding a lantern and staff, standing atop a mound of black skulls. Below, a group of robed cultists in white and black hooded garments perform a ritual in a circle around a mystical diagram on the ground, with floating golden halos, lit candles, and vibrant pink and blue flames. The background is black with ornate white line art, banners, eyes, and moths, creating an occult atmosphere.
